matches.rationale: GT-1 concerns the methodological rigor of deriving JMMD via the Representer theorem in Section 3.1, specifically the unjustified elimination of tensor product operators. Finding 1 identifies a notational inconsistency about matrix notation (I_{n×n} vs 1_{n×n}) in Theorem 1 (Section 3.2). These are different defects in different locations addressing different issues.
